0022600037.text: The Bulls (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak, 0-3 at home) host the Atlanta Hawks (7-5, first in the Southeast, fifth in the East, coming off a loss), with Chicago sitting 14th in the East and 5.5 games back in the Central. Chicago is without Norman Powell, who is out with shoulder inflammation and averages 19.3 points per game this season, as well as Dailyn Swain and Tobe Awaka, both listed as out with back issues. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bulls won all three matchups in 2025-26, most recently 126-123 in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
